text: Why did Ariana Grande and Disney both get beat this Thanksgiving?
And the winner wasn't even a new movie!
Focker In-Law, the fourth Meet the Parents film, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro, made about five point three million dollars on opening day.
On a reported ninety million dollar budget.
Disney's brand-new witch movie, Hexed, did better, about seven point six million. But both are tracking below forecasts.
Meanwhile, the Hunger Games prequel, in week two, made fifteen million on Wednesday alone.
Lowkey, big names aren't a guaranteed W anymore.
So... Focker In-Law or Hexed this weekend?
